adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.shortEffect: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.shortEffect: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.shortEffect: Damages the attacker if it contacts the Pokémon with a finishing hit.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.shortEffect: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.shortEffect: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.shortEffect: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

armor-tail.name: Armor Tail
armor-tail.shortEffect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

aroma-veil.name: Aroma Veil
aroma-veil.shortEffect: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.

aura-guard.name: Aura Guard
aura-guard.shortEffect: Reduces the amount of damage received by moves that make physical contact by 50%

battle-armor.name: Battle Armor
battle-armor.shortEffect: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.

big-pecks.name: Big Pecks
big-pecks.shortEffect: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering effects.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.shortEffect: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.shortEffect: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

cheek-pouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheek-pouch.shortEffect: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in sunshine.

clear-body.name: Clear Body
clear-body.shortEffect: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

commander.name: Commander
commander.shortEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.shortEffect: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.

compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.shortEffect: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.shortEffect: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.shortEffect: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

costar.name: Costar
costar.shortEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

cud-chew.name: Cud Chew
cud-chew.shortEffect: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

curious-medicine.name: Curious Medicine
curious-medicine.shortEffect: When the Pokémon is brought into battle, any stat alterations of allies are removed

cursed-body.name: Cursed Body
cursed-body.shortEffect: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.shortEffect: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

damp.name: Damp
damp.shortEffect: Prevents the use of explosive moves such as Self-Destruct by dampening its surroundings.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat sharply when its stats are lowered.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.shortEffect: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.shortEffect: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.shortEffect: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

drought.name: Drought
drought.shortEffect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

dry-skin.name: Dry Skin
dry-skin.shortEffect: Restores HP in rain or when hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in sunshine, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

early-bird.name: Early Bird
early-bird.shortEffect: The Pokémon awakens twice as fast as other Pokémon from sleep.

earth-eater.name: Earth Eater
earth-eater.shortEffect: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

eelevate.name: Eelevate
eelevate.shortEffect: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.shortEffect: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.

electric-surge.name: Electric Surge
electric-surge.shortEffect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.shortEffect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

emergency-exit.name: Emergency Exit
emergency-exit.shortEffect: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

fairy-aura.name: Fairy Aura
fairy-aura.shortEffect: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.

filter.name: Filter
filter.shortEffect: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

fire-mane.name: Fire Mane
fire-mane.shortEffect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.shortEffect: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.shortEffect: Powers up the Pokémon's Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.

flower-veil.name: Flower Veil
flower-veil.shortEffect: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.shortEffect: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.shortEffect: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.shortEffect: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.shortEffect: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

fur-coat.name: Fur Coat
fur-coat.shortEffect: Halves the damage from physical moves onto this Pokémon.

gale-wings.name: Gale Wings
gale-wings.shortEffect: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is full.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.shortEffect: Makes the Pokémon eat a held Berry when its HP drops to half or less, which is sooner than usual.

good-as-gold.name: Good as Gold
good-as-gold.shortEffect: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.shortEffect: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

grass-pelt.name: Grass Pelt
grass-pelt.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat in Grassy Terrain.

grassy-surge.name: Grassy Surge
grassy-surge.shortEffect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

guard-dog.name: Guard Dog
guard-dog.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

guts.name: Guts
guts.shortEffect: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.shortEffect: May create another Berry after one is used.

healer.name: Healer
healer.shortEffect: Sometimes heals an ally's status condition.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.shortEffect: The heatproof body of the Pokémon halves the damage from Fire-type moves that hit it.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.shortEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

hunger-switch.name: Hunger Switch
hunger-switch.shortEffect: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.shortEffect: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.shortEffect: Heals status conditions if it's raining.

hyper-cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.shortEffect: The Pokémon's proud of its powerful pincers. They prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

ice-body.name: Ice Body
ice-body.shortEffect: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a Snowstorm.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.shortEffect: Raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon by illuminating the surroundings.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.shortEffect: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in the party's last spot.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.shortEffect: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.shortEffect: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.shortEffect: Passes through the opposing Pokémon's barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.

innards-out.name: Innards Out
innards-out.shortEffect: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

inner-focus.name: Inner Focus
inner-focus.shortEffect: The Pokémon's intensely focused, and that protects the Pokémon from flinching.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.shortEffect: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.shortEffect: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.

justified.name: Justified
justified.shortEffect: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.

keen-eye.name: Keen Eye
keen-eye.shortEffect: Keen eyes prevent other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon's accuracy.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.shortEffect: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

leaf-guard.name: Leaf Guard
leaf-guard.shortEffect: Prevents status conditions in sunny weather.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.shortEffect: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

libero.name: Libero
libero.shortEffect: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use.

lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning-rod.shortEffect: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of being hit by Electric-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.

limber.name: Limber
limber.shortEffect: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.

liquid-ooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquid-ooze.shortEffect: Oozed liquid has strong stench, which damages attackers using any draining move.

liquid-voice.name: Liquid Voice
liquid-voice.shortEffect: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

long-reach.name: Long Reach
long-reach.shortEffect: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

magic-bounce.name: Magic Bounce
magic-bounce.shortEffect: Reflects status moves, instead of getting hit by them.

magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.shortEffect: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

magician.name: Magician
magician.shortEffect: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.

magma-armor.name: Magma Armor
magma-armor.shortEffect: The Pokémon is covered with hot magma, which prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

marvel-scale.name: Marvel Scale
marvel-scale.shortEffect: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost the Defense stat if it has a status condition.

mega-launcher.name: Mega Launcher
mega-launcher.shortEffect: Powers up aura and pulse moves.

mega-sol.name: Mega Sol
mega-sol.shortEffect: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.shortEffect: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.shortEffect: Changes the Pokémon's type depending on the terrain.

minus.name: Minus
minus.shortEffect: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

mirror-armor.name: Mirror Armor
mirror-armor.shortEffect: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

mold-breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.shortEffect: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

moody.name: Moody
moody.shortEffect: Raises one stat sharply and lowers another every turn.

motor-drive.name: Motor Drive
motor-drive.shortEffect: Boosts its Speed stat if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.shortEffect: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.shortEffect: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes when its HP is full.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.shortEffect: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Mummy.

natural-cure.name: Natural Cure
natural-cure.shortEffect: All status conditions heal when the Pokémon switches out.

no-guard.name: No Guard
no-guard.shortEffect: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.shortEffect: The Pokémon is oblivious, and that keeps it from being infatuated or falling for taunts.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.shortEffect: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.shortEffect: Protects the Pokémon from things like sand, hail, and powder.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.shortEffect: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

own-tempo.name: Own Tempo
own-tempo.shortEffect: This Pokémon has its own tempo, and that prevents it from becoming confused.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.shortEffect: Steals an item from an attacker that made direct contact.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.shortEffect: The Pokémon may pick up the item an opposing Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

piercing-drill.name: Piercing Drill
piercing-drill.shortEffect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.shortEffect: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

plus.name: Plus
plus.shortEffect: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

poison-heal.name: Poison Heal
poison-heal.shortEffect: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned, instead of losing HP.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.shortEffect: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

poison-touch.name: Poison Touch
poison-touch.shortEffect: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.shortEffect: Gives priority to a status move.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.shortEffect: By putting pressure on the opposing Pokémon, it raises their PP usage.

protean.name: Protean
protean.shortEffect: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use.

psychic-surge.name: Psychic Surge
psychic-surge.shortEffect: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

punk-rock.name: Punk Rock
punk-rock.shortEffect: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

pure-power.name: Pure Power
pure-power.shortEffect: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

purifying-salt.name: Purifying Salt
purifying-salt.shortEffect: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

queenly-majesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenly-majesty.shortEffect: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.shortEffect: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
quick-feet.shortEffect: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
rain-dish.shortEffect: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.shortEffect: Dark-, Ghost-, and Bug-type moves scare the Pokémon and boost its Speed stat.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.shortEffect: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.shortEffect: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.shortEffect: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.shortEffect: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.shortEffect: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.shortEffect: Becomes competitive and deals more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but deals less to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

rock-head.name: Rock Head
rock-head.shortEffect: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.shortEffect: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.shortEffect: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

sand-force.name: Sand Force
sand-force.shortEffect: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

sand-rush.name: Sand Rush
sand-rush.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

sand-spit.name: Sand Spit
sand-spit.shortEffect: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

sand-stream.name: Sand Stream
sand-stream.shortEffect: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's evasion in a sandstorm.

sap-sipper.name: Sap Sipper
sap-sipper.shortEffect: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move, instead of taking damage.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.shortEffect: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

screen-cleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screen-cleaner.shortEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

seed-sower.name: Seed Sower
seed-sower.shortEffect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

serene-grace.name: Serene Grace
serene-grace.shortEffect: Boosts the likelihood of additional effects occurring when attacking.

shadow-tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.shortEffect: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadow to prevent it from escaping.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.shortEffect: The Pokémon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
sheer-force.shortEffect: Removes additional effects to increase the power of moves when attacking.

shell-armor.name: Shell Armor
shell-armor.shortEffect: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.shortEffect: This Pokémon's dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.

skill-link.name: Skill Link
skill-link.shortEffect: Maximizes the number of times multi-strike moves hit.

slush-rush.name: Slush Rush
slush-rush.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a Snowstorm.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.shortEffect: Powers up moves if they become critical hits when attacking.

snow-warning.name: Snow Warning
snow-warning.shortEffect: The Pokémon summons a Snowstorm when it enters a battle.

solar-power.name: Solar Power
solar-power.shortEffect: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat in sunny weather, but HP decreases every turn.

solid-rock.name: Solid Rock
solid-rock.shortEffect: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.shortEffect: Soundproofing of the Pokémon itself gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.shortEffect: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.

spicy-spray.name: Spicy Spray
spicy-spray.shortEffect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.shortEffect: Doubles the damage dealt to the target's replacement if the target switches out.

stall.name: Stall
stall.shortEffect: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.shortEffect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.shortEffect: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.

stance-change.name: Stance Change
stance-change.shortEffect: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.

static.name: Static
static.shortEffect: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.shortEffect: The Pokémon's determination boosts the Speed stat each time the Pokémon flinches.

steely-spirit.name: Steely Spirit
steely-spirit.shortEffect: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.

stench.name: Stench
stench.shortEffect: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

sticky-hold.name: Sticky Hold
sticky-hold.shortEffect: Items held by the Pokémon are stuck fast and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

storm-drain.name: Storm Drain
storm-drain.shortEffect: Draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of being hit by Water-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.

strong-jaw.name: Strong Jaw
strong-jaw.shortEffect: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortEffect: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.

suction-cups.name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.shortEffect: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.

super-luck.name: Super Luck
super-luck.shortEffect: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

supersweet-syrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweet-syrup.shortEffect: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

supreme-overlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supreme-overlord.shortEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted by 10% for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

surge-surfer.name: Surge Surfer
surge-surfer.shortEffect: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortEffect: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

sweet-veil.name: Sweet Veil
sweet-veil.shortEffect: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.

swift-swim.name: Swift Swim
swift-swim.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.shortEffect: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.shortEffect: The attacker will receive the same status condition if it inflicts a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon.

tangled-feet.name: Tangled Feet
tangled-feet.shortEffect: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.

technician.name: Technician
technician.shortEffect: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.shortEffect: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.

thermal-exchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermal-exchange.shortEffect: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

thick-fat.name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.shortEffect: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortEffect: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

tough-claws.name: Tough Claws
tough-claws.shortEffect: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

toxic-debris.name: Toxic Debris
toxic-debris.shortEffect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

trace.name: Trace
trace.shortEffect: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.shortEffect: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target Pokémon's stat changes.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.shortEffect: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.shortEffect: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

unseen-fist.name: Unseen Fist
unseen-fist.shortEffect: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected. This damage is reduced to 25%

vital-spirit.name: Vital Spirit
vital-spirit.shortEffect: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

volt-absorb.name: Volt Absorb
volt-absorb.shortEffect: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.

wandering-spirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wandering-spirit.shortEffect: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.shortEffect: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move, instead of taking damage.

water-bubble.name: Water Bubble
water-bubble.shortEffect: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

water-veil.name: Water Veil
water-veil.shortEffect: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

weak-armor.name: Weak Armor
weak-armor.shortEffect: Physical attacks to the Pokémon lower its Defense stat but sharply raise its Speed stat.

well-baked-body.name: Well-Baked Body
well-baked-body.shortEffect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

white-smoke.name: White Smoke
white-smoke.shortEffect: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

wind-power.name: Wind Power
wind-power.shortEffect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

zero-to-hero.name: Zero to Hero
zero-to-hero.shortEffect: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
